content.label:
I love the app so far. I’ve been using it for almost 2 months now and I’ve built daily habits that are starting to become automatic. A few improvements: 
1. Hide any task which isn’t due for the day. I had gym tasks which are for specific days but they are visible on days they aren’t due (slightly greyed out) and it’s confusing, I only want to see what I need to do for the day. 
2. It would be great to have more pages, currently there are only four. I want one for each life pillar e.g learning, health etc
Waste of money this app! Don't purchase

I’ve tried a lot of habit trackers and always come back to Streaks. Have learnt not to look elsewhere now. Easy to use, but powerful with Health integration, Shortcuts supports and all the widgets you’ll ever need. Just the best!
the simplest thing like adding a new habit is very confusing, i’ve got a million apps for everything and this is the only app i’ve ever have this issue with.

Great app to be fair, I just really wish the gold streak was utilised a bit better. So an option to get gold on a task on a high streak which is lost when streak breaks. At the minute the gold features pointless for me.
Excellent little app that is simple but informative to use.  Been using  week and can already feel new, sustainable habits been formed.  Very pleased!

title.label: Amazing from design, functionality and importance

content.label: Worth every penny!!

Been using this app for more than 2 years now and it has transformed my life. I quickly filled all 24 and wished for more but when I found out there was a good reason for the limit I realised the sense in that and chose more wisely what I added. I do adjust them occasionally but mostly they are now pretty refined and help me in so many personal and professional ways throughout the week. It’s my todo list, diary, habit tracker, project progresser and life coach all in one!

I can see from some of the less recent reviews that there have been a lot of changes recently, for example there are now 24 available habits instead of 12 like one of the reviews states. It has almost everything you could possibly need from this type of app. There are so many different presets, almost every possible thing you could want, is easy to navigate and is very customisable. You know when you go on to an app and you think of some things that would make the experience better? I can only think of two and only one of those even affects the experience in the slightest.

I would highly recommend getting this app if you want to build healthy habits and keep them going.

If you’ve read Atomic Habits, you know that picking up and doing small tasks daily is the secret to turning them into habits. This is a great app to help with that process. It’s polished, easy to use, and can read data from e.g., the Health app so habits like walking steps daily aren’t things you need to manually complete.

I regret so much paying £6 for this app it’s such a waste of money and time. It takes ages to set it up and has a very difficult to read interface. A habit tracker app shouldn’t be this difficult to use it’s ridiculous. It put me off doing anything which is opposite what it should be doing.
Amazing project
This app has kept me consistent with my goals and I can’t complain about that at all
Fantastic app which is very reasonably priced
Love the idea of this app but can’t see how to set alerts and without alerts I forget it exists making it quite useless to me
This app is awful to use and confusing

title.label: Too expensive for what it is

content.label:
I paid 6 GPB for this app and must say I‘m massively disappointed by the quality considering the price point. 
The theme is barely customizable - the only wallpapers I liked color wise had emoji style watermarks. Why can’t I just take a photo as a wallpaper or choose my own colors with fades or disable the watermarks?
The user experience is terrible - considering this should be an intuitive and simple app it takes too long to figure out in which case the the dots are responsive and which case  they aren‘t. I only use the app to track one thing, so the Up Next feature was confusing and it took me 20 minutes to figure out what it was. Moreover, I wish there were more actual icons. The data visualization for the stats for me and my friend who shared a task with me could be improved. Lastly, it looks like there‘s a bug where if you set the color for the icon you cannot unset it anymore - the icon is permanently filled. 
Overall, great if the app only cost 2 GBP but considering this is supposedly the market leader for habit tracking apps it‘s really bad and too expensive. Very disappointing.
Works amazing with shortcuts
Streaks is a beautifully designed app and has really helped me take control of my life. I especially love being able to tick off my habits from the watch
Randomly deletes all of your progress. Hugely annoying and no way to restore as there is no account option etc. Trying to find a way to get a refund

title.label: No idea what’s going on with settings anymore

content.label: App mostly functions but the settings now makes no sense at all. I don’t understand how to remove or add an archived task - apps just disappear when you click them? Very frustrating.

title.label: Best app I’ve ever paid for

content.label:
This app has genuinely been such a lifestyle game-changer for me. The ease of use and interface is exceptional, it’s entirely programmable to your own world and schedule but not in an overwhelming way. 

Anyone who has the tendency for adhd-like trends and challenges such as time management, motivation to begin tasks, remembering to take care of yourself when life gets busy… this is for you.

Honestly, first product review I’ve ever left and I did it entirely unprompted; speaks volumes about how much I rate this app. If it were to ever stop running my life would be dramatically affected. I rely on it massively!
I’m on iPhone 15 Pro and Apple Watch Series 10, if I complete a habit on the phone it does not reflect on the watch. You also can’t undo an accidental completion on the watch.

Perfect routine app with a lot of options. Interactive widgets. Connection with Health. Up to 16 goals. But does not have a good way to view all goals progress / percentages / weekly progress or track it in a wholesome way. Only total % and month % available which is not very useful to micromanage. Excellent app otherwise, especially for its price!

The Streaks app offers a fantastic concept for habit tracking, but its execution falls short. Synchronisation between the Apple Watch, iPhone, and Mac is frustratingly unreliable. Tasks completed on the Apple Watch frequently fail to update on other devices, and activity ring progress doesn’t show correctly on the watch. Likewise Mac or iPhone to the watch. 

This is particularly disappointing given that iCloud sync is enabled on all devices, background app refresh is on, and the devices are connected to fast, reliable Wi-Fi. Considering the small amount of data being transferred when a task is completed, the sync issues are difficult to excuse.

Support was unhelpful, even infering they don’t have an Apple Watch for testing. While the idea is solid, the app's poor sync and lack of refinement make it hard to recommend in its current state.
Endlessly customisable, easy to set up and finally an app that gives you freedom and flexibility in setting up widgets
I don’t know what happened in version 10, but I’m only getting notifications to remind me of tasks every three days, causing me to miss completing them and then break my streak.

title.label: Useful For My Needs & Good Price But With Slight Annoyances

content.label:
Useful app that wasn’t too expensive or had a subscription. I can’t remember things easily so I wanted a way to add reminders to my phone so that they would remind me all day and count different meditations etc using the Dynamic Island and Lock Screen as a permanent reminder.

Unfortunately while this app does seem to use the Dynamic Island it (as far as I can tell) is only if you are currently running a time based Streak that has a timer that has actually been started. You can’t manually choose to keep a reminder or a none time based Streak in the Dynamic Island or in a persistent notification to remind yourself throughout the day.

The lock screen medication countdowns are useful ie so I can see that I have 3 of 4 tablets left today etc but it’s a bit annoying having multiple and not being able to specify which ones I want to see and when.

I found a slight workaround that involves using different pages for different streaks and then hiding the ones that I don’t need to see so that they won’t show on my Lock Screen or in widgets etc, but I think that’s more annoying than just being able to use a menu option to exclude certain Streaks from your screen.

Same goes for manually updating ones with multiple sections throughout the day like if I forgot to log 3 tablets then why I can’t just manually set the amount instead of having to manually press it for each missed time, which is even more annoying when you make a mistake and have to go through even more unnecessary steps to undo and then redo it all again…

I really hope this is possible in a future update because it seems easy enough to do considering the current settings allow for certain Streaks that persist on your screen, widgets, notifications and in the Dynamic Island but you get little control over how and when and which are shown without hiding them completely.

Despite this I still found the widgets useful and visual enough that they work as great reminders throughout the day and useful logs over time and I can quickly visualise how many tablets I have taken / are remaining and see it on my Apple Watch.

I love the Shortcuts integration too which fit right into an existing Shortcut I had made to log medication. Before I had struggled to find a way to log my total daily dose and then to count down every time I logged a tablet and some days I take more which other apps couldn’t handle without ruining the daily amount but Streaks can.

Please expand on this customisation and make it so you can select which streaks to use in the shortcut even if they are completed that day and allow us to manually choose which Streaks appear especially in the Dynamic Island and for how long they persist. If I could do that then this would the perfect app and hopefully with future updates it will be.

What an amazing app, especially for addictive personalities. This app came into my life at the right time, but I do wish I found it sooner. Go for your goals and dreams through habits practiced every day and keep track of them here.

Once you’re up and running (which doesn’t take long to figure out) Streaks is a simple, satisfying and for me extremely effective way to start forming new habits, or remembering to do something. I’ve played more guitar since downloading streaks 3 weeks ago than I have in the previous 3 years… and I’ve remembered to take my vitamins! Highly recommended, coming from someone who tries to limit screen time as much as possible.

I bought this app because it has widgets. However these are only shortcuts to open the app. I was hoping to be quickly tick off my habits. The app also insists on breaking up your streaks in to separate categories such as health and it’s tedious not having them all on one screen. Maybe there is a way to change this but the app is quite minimal, which I like to a point, but instructions are then too vague

title.label: I have used the app everyday for years

content.label: Incredible app for forming and sticking to good habits. Rich functionality, behind a intuitive interface on across iPhone, iPad, Mac and Watch.
Amazing how something so simple can make such a big difference. The only thing is that because the app is a OTP (one time payment) the developers don’t seem that keen to add new features

title.label: Customer support is amazing. App helped me improve my life!

content.label: This app has helped me meet all sorts of personal goals, from losing weight, increasing fitness, mental health. I was motivated to write this review after I got a bug in the app, and you’ll notice it is 5 stars… in this globalised day and age it is relatively rare to get speedy customer support from a real person. But I did and they fixed my problem. Great app and great developers.

title.label: Great app that’s flexible at the cost of a little confusion

content.label:
I’ve not come up with a goal I want to track yet that I can’t do in Streaks. It’s great at nudging me into good habits.

This flexibility comes at the cost of a UI that’s sometimes pretty confusing. For example, it’s not particularly intuitive to know that you can cycle between states from the calendar view if you normally use the gauge view. However, the overall experience is great.

Best way I’ve found so far to use the gamified approach of Brilliant or Duolingo to keep you motivated to build a habit or complete a long task.

title.label: Much more than a simple task-tracking tool

content.label:
Streaks makes tracking completed tasks an absolute breeze. The app is well-designed, with a brilliantly intuitive (and good-looking) interface, so that core functionality is pretty much entirely self-explanatory.

That’s an achievement by itself, but what really blew me away was how deeply customisable, flexible, and powerful the app is if you take a bit of time to dive into the menus and explore what it’s really capable of: custom task scheduling, automatic reminders, finding trends in completion data, the list of features goes on and on.

One of the very few apps I use every day, and I’ve come to rely on Streaks to manage much of my day-to-day work both personally and professionally. 

Absolute gem of an app.

My mate recommended this app and I was slightly dubious, but it really has changed my life. I’m always starting a fitness regimen and I forget to do it for 2 days, then it’s gone and all the hard work is wasted. This app has made me form good habits and I don’t want to start from zero again…so I do my exercises regardless of time of night, mindset or tiredness. I’ve now added a few lifestyle reminders - like calling a friend, heating healthy etc - and it’s be great. Highly recommend.

title.label: Great app, great Apple health integration

content.label: The app is great, probably would be a four star by itself as it is an amazing app but sometimes paying for apps can be a bit much for some people but it’s five stars because of how it can use info from Apple health and put info into Apple health

Takes a while to find where everything is, some features are relatively hidden, which isn’t great for UX. The features and functionality present are well thought out. But for the cost, it should not be artificially limiting its users to 24 total active tasks. I can see the limit used to be 12, which would be inexcusable. I can understand how a limit can force the user to decide what’s actually important - but that’s not something the app should impose upon paying customers. 

It would be good to have a habit for a certain medication being taken x times per week. Although this is a restriction on Apple’s Health API.

The only thing that has kept me going during a hard transition towards clean & healthy living! I’m motivated m, I’m mindful and I’m keeping on top of all my healthy habits thanks to Streak! Highly recommend
App time to time gets stuck in logo screen when opened. Have to restart the phone for it to work. Makes it unusable.
Please add a list view for the habits

2. Please improve the  sync/ work with Garmin/fit bit to track steps/exercise/sleeping

This app has revolutionised how I do my daily habits. I recommend it to anyone who will listen at the moment. Thank you so much for making this app!

title.label: From someone who hated the to begin with!

content.label: Once I learnt just how much the app did, and how to reposition icons, and the eminence amount of tasks and how they each respond in app, I really can say I’ve been doing more of what I need to because of this app, brilliant!

title.label: Problem with the colors in the widget

content.label: Amazing app but need to improve this as longe as the widget is the only thing I use
Fantastic app, worth every penny

title.label: Makes your life better if you have a little discipline

content.label: Wouldn’t say life changing because you’re still you, and you have to have some level of discipline for the app to be beneficial. But Streaks has definitely changed my life for the better. The level of detail you can go to on each task is amazing - just started using negative tasks too - but you could also keep it simple. I have notifications off but still appreciated the app prompting me to amend a task I was struggling with. Been using for three months now and can safely say that this app has really supported me in making good changes. Highly recommended.

Probably the most elegant, well thought-out apps I've ever come across. Such a gorgious and brilliantly executed interface. Oozes quality. Best of all? It actually inspires you to beat your demons and live the life you reallyl want. The saying is - 'hard choices, easy life' - but this app is very helpful in making those hard choices just a little more inviting. Bravo team Streaks - you NAILED it!

title.label: The Best App in the Store

content.label: As someone who has dedicated much of my personal, academic & professional life researching into the flow state, I can unquestionably say this is my favourite app… ever! In fact with all the advances in AI, I was seriously considering ditching Apple, but this app made me think twice, syncing so brilliantly as it does with the Watch. Every day I wake up to the same blank slate, then tick off my vitamins and supplements, it automatically registers when I’ve used my Bluetooth scales, and then it’s workout time, I burn 700 calories before I sit at my computer ( which is ok when I’m nearly touching 70 in a couple of weeks) then I tick off ‘homework’, two sets of three pomodoro sessions, three sets of twenty minutes of reading/studying… oh and I take at least one photo before I go home, where I check off some house cleaning and two sessions of playing a musical instrument… oh and it also tracks when I wash my hands, so I set a minimum of seven times a day. I only just discovered that it also has some fantastic watch faces which I have just installed. These are just my preferences but there are loads to choose from, many of them no brainers and all of them allowing you to set an easily achievable threshold and see it slowly increase automatically over the forthcoming weeks and months. Guys, if you wanna beta tester, I’m well up for it, you may even convince me to save up for one of these new VR headsets… I can’t imagine how good this app will be when you’re wearing one of those!
